review: All ten complete files read: parent Friends panel, chat board, glyph renderer wrapper, isolated copy, hosted mission entry, board requests and synthetic tests. First-party UI code only; no copied media or account data.

Accepted friend action opens existing hosted-room controls; another explicit action inspects an exact room under matching unexpired profile authorization. Account changes, wrong room and left membership suppress mission display. Existing owner review/result components remain the action authority boundary.

Message send and sticker cursor change use explicit request IDs; rendering/polling alone cannot propose room tasks. Sent artifact generation and digest are pinned; a pending new composition does not present an old generation as its result.

Received glyph store is isolated in memory. Connecting its client tools and queueing artifact context each require a separate click. Context copy labels qualitative claims and queue-only confirmation; no empirical certification, sender credential or program grant is transferred.
Glyph markup comes from the shared schema-checked scenario renderer, not an arbitrary message HTML field. Renderer and scene contracts remain separately reviewed shared dependencies.
Fixture accounts, rooms, request IDs and tokens are synthetic with mocked HTTP/native controls. Voice start/consent and hosted task action are not executed in these tests.
limits: Private source proposal only; no commit, push, package, deployment or new authority.
Existing voice bridge/API, account/chat state, glyph store/transport, shared contracts and hosted mission controls are separate dependencies; this preview is not standalone.
Mocks and component tests do not establish real consent, room membership cutoff, game result, stream context pickup or native chat-log insertion.
Parent panel is read in full; local transport and actual party audio require their own qualification.
